seo_title: Technical SEO & Web Architecture Audit | LANZAESTUDIO
seo_desc: Is your website invisible on Google? We optimize your platform's technical architecture to skyrocket organic traffic and improve the user experience.
author_pitch: I have audited hundreds of B2B platforms stuck on page 10 of Google. As CEO of Lanza Estudio, I know that a pretty design doesn't sell if the code is broken. We transform your website's structure so search engines love it and your clients find you organically.
title: Stop being invisible on Google: Web architecture to dominate your industry
body:
Is your website a black hole that fails to attract a single visit from potential clients?

You invest thousands of dollars in visual redesigns, but your company still doesn't appear on Google when clients search for your services. This invisibility problem is usually rooted in the code: slow loading times, chaotic URL structures, and poor Technical SEO that blocks crawlers. Every day you spend outside the top rankings, you are handing over your organic traffic and sales to your competition.

The trap of Pretty Design without Optimized Code

Many agencies sell you visually stunning websites, but built on heavy templates that sink the user experience (UX) and scare off Google. A spectacular website that nobody finds is just a very expensive digital brochure.

Our solution: Core Vitals and SEO Restructuring

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we rebuild the foundations of your platform. We apply data engineering to align your technical architecture with Google's algorithmic demands, ensuring perfect crawling and extreme loading speed.

  1. Deep Crawl Audit: We detect and eliminate 404 errors, redirect chains, and duplicate content that are penalizing your domain.
  2. Core Web Vitals Optimization: We minify the code, defer script loading, and optimize the server to reduce latency to a minimum.
  3. Strategic Information Hierarchy: We redesign the internal linking structure and URLs to distribute authority and boost your transactional keywords.
  4. Radical UX Improvement: We adapt the interface to make navigation seamless and retain the user, sending positive quality signals to search engines.

The Real Impact on Client Acquisition

  • Organic Traffic Multiplication: Climb Google rankings rapidly, attracting highly qualified visits without paying per click.
  • Higher Retention Rate: A frictionless and ultra-fast user experience reduces bounce rates and drastically increases B2B conversion.
  • Sustainable Domain Authority: Build a solid digital asset that dominates search in the long term, regardless of algorithm updates.
